entries.title: US-0102 closed — webview project context strip
entries.what_changed: Implemented project context toolbar in Board/Deliverables, panel titles, selectProject postMessage, switchActiveMeridianProjectById. US-0102, v2.04-S1, EPIC-13 complete. Extension 1.1.10.
entries.why_changed: Manager must see which docs/ is active without hunting status bar; persisted choice on panel reopen.
entries.impact: Multi-product monorepo UX complete for extension v4 line.

entries.title: v2.04 + US-0102 webview project context
entries.what_changed: Reopened EPIC-13 (active). Planned v2.04 and US-0102: project context strip in Board/Deliverables, persisted active project on panel reopen, switch from toolbar. No code until /refine-us.
entries.why_changed: US-0101 persistence is invisible in kanban UI; manager must see docs/ path and not re-pick project on every Board open.
entries.impact: Implementation blocked until US-0102 refined (ready: true).

entries.title: EPIC-13 + v2.03 multi-product docs resolution
entries.what_changed: New epic EPIC-13 and version v2.03 for monorepo multi-product support: .meridian/projects.json manifest A + docs/ discovery B, extension active project picker, kit templates and guides. US-0101 created, refined, and closed retroactively after implementation.
entries.why_changed: Managers need several Meridian products per repo without hard-coded app-desktop/docs; Meridian protocol requires US/version/epic before or at close of work.
entries.impact: Extension validate uses packageRoot; agents follow same manifest contract; EPIC-13 complete in one sprint.

entries.title: US-0100 kit install — multi-IDE and surgical sync
entries.what_changed: Implemented surgical sync_cursor_kit.sh (orphan prune, --cursor-only/--claude-only/--no-sync), install-meridian-kit.sh fixes, IDE matrix docs. Cursor+Claude get adapters; Antigravity uses .agent/ only. US-0100, v2.02, v2.02-S1, EPIC-12 closed.
entries.why_changed: Managers need distributable kit working across IDEs without wiping custom .cursor/ content.
entries.impact: meridian-kit tarball ready for release; npm CLI remains backlog.

entries.title: EPIC-12 Kit distribution — revert EPIC-01 extension
entries.what_changed: Reverted EPIC-01 to complete/v0 only. Created EPIC-12 (Kit distribution, active) for v2.02/US-0100. US-0100 epic frontmatter and sprint table now reference EPIC-12.
entries.why_changed: EPIC-01 is closed foundation work; kit installer is a new product capability — Meridian prefers new epic over reopening complete epic.
entries.impact: EPIC-12 active; US-0100 unchanged in scope; board sync required.

entries.title: v2.02 kit distribution — US-0100 and surgical IDE sync
entries.what_changed: Added version v2.02 (Kit distribution), sprint v2.02-S1, and US-0100 for meridian-kit tarball, install-meridian-kit.sh, and non-destructive .cursor/.claude symlink sync. EPIC-01 extended with v2.02; supersedes deferred installer scope from US-0006/US-0007 for bash/tarball path.
entries.why_changed: Install scripts and package-kit existed without backlog documentation; managers need formal acceptance for distributable kit without monorepo and safe adapter upgrades.
entries.impact: v2.02 planned parallel to v5 extension wizards; implementation blocked until /refine-us on US-0100.
